Variables.Name: PackageMapClass
Variables.Description: The class name for the PackageMap to be loaded

Variables.Name: PackageMap
Variables.Description: Package map between local and remote. (negotiates net serialization)

Variables.Name: SentTemporaries
Variables.Description: This actor is bNetTemporary, which means it should never be replicated after it's initial packet is complete

Variables.Name: ViewTarget
Variables.Description: The actor that is currently being viewedcontrolled by the owning controller

Variables.Name: NumPacketIdBits
Variables.Description: Number of bits used for the packet id in the current packet.

Variables.Name: PlayerId
Variables.Description: Net id of remote player on this connection. Only valid on client connections (server side).

Variables.Name: LastRecvAckTime
Variables.Description: The last time an ack was received

Variables.Name: ChannelsToTick
Variables.Description:
The channels that need ticking. This will be a subset of OpenChannels, only including
	  channels that need to process either dormancy or queued bunches. Should be a significant
	  optimization over ticking and calling virtual functions on the potentially hundreds of
	  OpenChannels every frame.
